newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight - Brazil the main origin.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight - Brazil the main origin.

text.p: Brazil remained the main origin quoted in new enquiries and in reported fixtures, brokers said.
Czarnikow-Rionda 22,000/23,000 bulk from Rosario to US Gulf or Atlantic end July/early Aug and 14,000 bagged Thailand to Karachi/Red Sea/East Africa prompt.
Cargill 14,000 bagged from Santos to East and West Africa, Red Sea, Indian Ocean, Med, Black Sea or Baltic early Aug.
Cargill 25,000 bulk Santos or Parangua to Baltic, Black Sea or Med.
Genoc 20,000/25,000 bulk Parangaua to Baltic or Black Sea prompt.
Dreyfus 14,000 bagged South Brazil to Red Sea end July.
Sugar Chartering 12,000 bulk Philippines to US Gulf or Atlantic prompt.
Amerop 20.000/25,000 bulk Rosario to US Gulf or Atlantic prompt.
